item.title: Version 0.0.18
item.description:
## What's new in v0.0.18
**7-Day windows now track the live API**
The popover's 7-Day section used to hard-code Sonnet/Opus/Design rows. When Claude.ai stopped reporting those windows, they showed a misleading **0%** instead of disappearing.
- Per-model windows now render **only when the API actually reports them** — a missing window means "not provisioned", so the row is hidden rather than shown as empty. - Any new window Claude.ai returns is surfaced automatically (no app update needed), including codenamed credit pools like `amber_ladder`, shown with their dollar balance (e.g. **$0 / $2,500**). - Known windows keep friendly names (Sonnet, Opus, Design); unrecognized codenames are humanized (`amber_ladder` → "Amber Ladder").

item.title: Version 0.0.17
item.description:
## What's new in v0.0.17
**Cask renamed: `claudebar-menubar`**
brew install --cask chiliec/tap/claudebar-menubar
The short name `claudebar` in the central Homebrew tap belongs to an unrelated project. Using a unique short name avoids `brew upgrade` silently replacing your install with the wrong app.
If you installed an earlier `chiliec/tap/claudebar`, uninstall it first:
brew uninstall --cask claudebar --force brew install --cask chiliec/tap/claudebar-menubar

item.title: Version 0.0.16
item.description:
## What's new in v0.0.16
**Homebrew Cask install + in-app Sparkle 2 updates**
brew install --cask chiliec/tap/claudebar
First launch needs no manual `xattr` or right-click bypass — the cask strips quarantine on install, and updates ship via Sparkle inside the app.
**Fixes since v0.0.15 (retracted: dyld couldn't find bundled Sparkle.framework)** - Inject `@executable_path/../Frameworks` rpath so the binary finds bundled Sparkle.framework at runtime
**Manual install (no Homebrew)**
Download the `.zip` below, unzip, drag `ClaudeBar.app` to `/Applications`. You'll see a one-time Gatekeeper prompt — right-click → Open to bypass it.
